principles.name: Separate luminance structure from chromatic coding
requirements: Compute required text and boundary contrast
Provide a non-color cue for every consequential state

principles.name: Specify appearance in context
requirements: Declare color space, white point, luminance, surround, adaptation, geometry, device, ambient, observer and task
Do not use raw RGB or HSL distance as perceptual evidence

principles.name: Design at retinal scale
requirements: Test actual angular size and eccentricity
Reinforce thin or peripheral chromatic cues

principles.name: Treat adaptation and illumination as state
requirements: Test theme, surround, ambient and transition conditions

principles.name: Encode meaning redundantly
requirements: Pair color with shape, text, pattern, position or luminance
Treat CVD simulation as audit aid, not human validation

principles.name: Allocate salience, not visual weight
requirements: Model multiscale feature contrast and task priority
Do not infer comprehension or balance from fixation alone

principles.name: Characterize the display pipeline
requirements: Declare gamut, transfer function, white, peak/minimum luminance, mapping and ambient

principles.name: Validate behavior, not palettes
requirements: Measure accuracy, misses, false alarms and response time for consequential tasks
